_comment: Deterministic skill-activation backstop for Nexus-Hub. Copy this file to .claude/skill-rules.json (or skill-rules.json at the repo root) and tailor the rules. The hooks that read it (skill-activation-suggest.py, skill-guard.py) are ADVISORY by default: they only SUGGEST a skill and never block. A rule blocks an edit ONLY when its enforcement is 'block' AND the environment sets NEXUS_SKILL_GUARD_BLOCK=1. This is a deterministic backstop to the model-judgment description triggering, aimed at the under-triggering the AGENTS.md description-style section acknowledges - not a replacement for it. See catalog/style-guides/skill-activation-rules.md for the full schema.

rules.message: Editing auth/security code - consider loading the security-review skill to check for OWASP issues before you claim it is done.
Writing source under src/ - consider test-driven-development (write the failing test first, then the code).
That reads like a completion claim - load verification-before-completion and run the proving command before claiming done.
Reviewing or preparing a change - apply review-trapdoors to pre-empt this project's recurring review blockers.
